title: NOT and the clearance decision
summary: Use NOT to flip a test, then combine AND, OR and NOT in one IF to decide which lines go on clearance.

blocks.text: End of season. The buyer wants a clearance list built from a rule, not from memory. A line goes on clearance when it is not a core line, it is either old or slow, and it has not already been marked down.
This rule needs three tools together: NOT to exclude lines, OR for "old or slow" and AND to require every part. IF then writes Clearance or Keep.

items: Objective: combine NOT, AND and OR inside IF.
You pass the mission at 75% or more in the Assessment.

blocks.text: NOT flips a result. NOT(TRUE) is FALSE and NOT(FALSE) is TRUE.
TRUE for every line that is not a Core line. It gives the same answer as D2<>"Core".
When one rule has several parts, write it in plain words first. Then turn each part into a test and join the tests.

blocks.caption: Plain words to formula parts
rows: old (weeks at or above the limit) or slow (sell-through below the floor)

blocks.text: Worked example: a seasonal line has been in store 14 weeks with 40% sell-through, not marked down. Not Core is TRUE. 14 weeks is at or above a 12-week limit, so the OR is TRUE even though 40% is above a 30% floor. Not yet marked down is TRUE. All three parts are TRUE, so the line goes on Clearance.
Tip: put OR inside AND. If you put the three parts side by side without AND, Excel cannot tell that all of them must be true.
Four questions on NOT and combined rules. Type numbers without commas, for example 2.

items: NOT flips TRUE and FALSE; NOT(x=y) is the same as x<>y.
Write the rule in plain words first, then turn each part into a test.
AND needs every part, OR needs one, and OR can sit inside AND.
Test the boundaries: >= includes the limit, < excludes it.

items.prompt: Which formula gives the same answer as =NOT(D2="Core")?

Rule: Clearance when the range is not Core AND (weeks in store is at least 12 OR sell-through is below 30%) AND the line is not yet marked down. Line 1: Seasonal, 13 weeks, 40%, not marked down. Line 2: Core, 30 weeks, 5%, not marked down. Line 3: Seasonal, 6 weeks, 29%, already marked down. Line 4: Seasonal, 3 weeks, 29%, not marked down. How many lines go on clearance?
Which test, placed inside AND, keeps a line out of clearance when E2 says "Yes" (already marked down)?
